## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` is clean
- [ ] `npm test` passes, and the new behaviour has a test that **fails without the change**
- [ ] `npm run check:deadcode` and `npm run check:openui-css` still pass
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry for a user-visible change (the release notes are taken from it)
- [ ] No new runtime dependency, no non-English text, no webfont, no CDN reference
- [ ] If the change touches the throughput phase: the verdict it produces is the one that describes
      what happened to the transfer, and only a `measured` number can rank an address
